lyrics_set.lyrics:
[Intro]
[Verse]
Watching the fog roll across the bay
Counting the secrets that the evening brings
A single candle flickers in the hall
Shadows are dancing against the garden wall
[Pre-Chorus]
The tide is turning slow and deep
Promises are secrets that we keep
[Chorus]
You are the anchor in my restless sea
The steady rhythm of the life in me
A golden thread woven through the gray
Holding the pieces of my world in place
[Verse]
Walking the path where the wild grass grows
Tracing the map that your memory shows
Every soft word is a stone in the path
Every silent look is a calm after the math

[Chorus]
You are the anchor in my restless sea
The steady rhythm of the life in me
A golden thread woven through the gray

The clouds may gather and the winds may blow
But your heart is the only home I know
